ps_agent: use a skill
ps_hook: no claude-code native entry
ps_hook_http: Claude Code hooks are keyed by the command of their first handler, and this hook has none
ps_sub: Claude Code skips a subagent without a description
ps_ws: transport "ws" is not supported by Claude Code
ps_keychain: secret env/API_KEY needs setup before Claude Code can use it
ps_native: claude-code native permission key defaultMode is not allow, deny or ask
